**PFOA → Serum Uric Acid (Model 6, UWLS meta-analysis)**

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| **β** | **0.111** |
| SE | 0.0067 |
| p | 7.63 × 10⁻⁵ |
| I² | 0% |
| N cycles | 5 |

The pooled meta-analytic β for LBXPFOA → LBXSUA is **0.111** (units: mg/dL uric acid per 1-SD increase in log₁₀-transformed PFOA, adjusted for age, age², sex, and race/ethnicity).
